pages.text: Grandma Bear gave each of the five a seed. They planted them in a row in the hillside garden.
Rudi patted soil over the seed. "When will it sprout?"
"In a few days." Rudi came back the very next morning.
The soil looked the same. Rudi dug up the seed and planted it elsewhere.
It didn't sprout there either. Rudi moved it again.
Rudi's seed went around the garden three whole times.
Green shoots appeared in the other four spots. Rudi's spot had only soil.
Grandma Bear brushed the dirt off Rudi's hands. "Seeds grow while we aren't watching."
Rudi buried the seed in one last spot, then sat outside the garden.
A few mornings later, a green shoot popped up in Rudi's spot.
